reason: A Cloudflare Tunnel integration that publishes the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI behind a shared-password gate, with optional authenticated remote settings and credential updates.

summaries.zh: 通过带共享密码保护的 Cloudflare Tunnel 将 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 发布到公网，并提供可选的远程设置管理。
summaries.en: Publishes the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI through a shared-password-protected Cloudflare Tunnel with optional authenticated remote settings management.

capabilities: Exposes the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI through a Cloudflare Tunnel
Runs the cloudflared executable as a child process
Protects public access with a shared password and session cookie
Proxies authenticated HTTP and WebSocket traffic to the local Web GUI
Can update configured credentials and settings through authenticated remote endpoints when enabled
